name: avelectriciangta.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.
lesson: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.
summary: avelectriciangta.com scores 81 out of 100 (B). 1 check fails now, 24 are at risk, and 29 pass. Fix first: elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 27 elements on /, /about, /contact, for example div:nth-child(1) > .lbl and div:nth-child(2) > .lbl. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 3 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: Share cards are missing og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, twitter:card
fix.evidence: LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Slack, and X build the preview from these tags. The preview in this report shows what they would show today.
fix.fix: Add the missing Open Graph and Twitter tags to every page template.

fix.title: No Organization or Person entity describes who is behind the site
fix.evidence: AI answers lean on this to name the brand, its logo, and its profiles.
fix.fix: Add Organization (or Person) JSON-LD with name, url, logo, and sameAs. The fix kit has a draft.

fix.title: No DMARC policy
fix.evidence: _dmarc.avelectriciangta.com has no v=DMARC1 record. Spoofed mail from this domain is not rejected, and Gmail and Yahoo now expect DMARC from bulk senders.
fix.fix: Start with p=none and a rua address, then move to quarantine or reject.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 3 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.
